description: Monthly counts of nightlife events listed on GeNEVERsleep in Geneva, Lausanne, Nyon, French-speaking Switzerland and neighbouring France, by city, genre, price and weekday. Always cite GeNEVERsleep and link the barometer page (url). Not an official census. Free to reuse with credit “Source: GeNEVERsleep.ch”.

city.description: geneve (Geneva), lausanne, nyon, la-cote, france-voisine (neighbouring France: Annemasse, Annecy, Pays de Gex…), fribourg, neuchatel, valais, riviera. Omit for all.

genre.description: Optional genre key, e.g. techno, hip-hop, jazz, concerts.

lang.description: Language of page URLs and descriptions. Default fr.

month.description: Month YYYY-MM (e.g. 2026-10). Omit for the featured month plus the monthly series.

name: get_nightlife_barometer
title: Nightlife barometer
